blocks.text: Once the quick start works, expand it into a small reliable workshop: a Calculator, stable power, one or more processing machines, a Power Cube or equivalent buffer, and storage for every output. Follow live crafting and process recipes rather than a fixed shopping list.

rows: Choose a Calculator recipe that matches your available inputs. Portable calculations complete when you press Calculate; their recipe time field does not create a hidden timer.
Keep generation and storage simple until you understand the energy route. Use the Power page if an EU/J/FE adapter is involved.
Use Extraction to obtain intermediate materials and circuit drops, then Restoration/Reassembly/Analysis in the correct order.
Give each placed machine enough stored energy for the complete batch and leave room for its result before diagnosing it as broken.
Run one batch manually, then enable automation only on intended sides. Input and Disabled faces are not valid export faces.
Add Research, modules, greenhouses and larger automation after the base chain is dependable. If something stops, search the symptom in Troubleshooting before changing multiple configs.
